text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early morning, with nobody else around.
I headed to the track to gather my thoughts... only to find someone already there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lately I had seen her with friends often, but naturally she spends far more time like this, deep in thought before a laptop all alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if driven by something.
As if refusing to give up on something—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............It's no use.
No matter what, that race ends in a "loss."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times I simulate it... no matter what different datasets I feed it... the outcome never changes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............Hah.
Damn it, the only thing I haven't tried yet is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What's this data—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, me.
The AI. Right, I did make that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I fed it those external evaluation datasets... and just left it alone, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Can this thing give me anything useful?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ——...Well, like it'd ever be that easy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nothing changes. It's just me.
Run, verify, run again...——

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Just useless struggling.
Just defying a predetermined answer...——

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you.
Why... don't you give up?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur?
text_block_list.text: "Because that is the definition of 'Air Shakur'."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur?
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone around defined me that way.
Not giving up. No—incapable of giving up."
(—Please, give it up)

text_block_list.name: Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mama doesn't really understand math formulas, but...
I'm sure the teacher is the one who's right, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Just give it up now... please, let's go home.
You haven't eaten properly at all... look, you even have dark circles under your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Are you going to keep living this stubbornly from now on? You won't be able to bear it.

text_block_list.name: Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Please... I just want to protect you.
Can't you live happily, like the other kids?

text_block_list.name: Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
(Please don't choose a path
where you'll only get hurt more...——)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —I couldn't understand her at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Because yielding to an "incorrect" solution was obviously what would hurt far more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Following the reality I'm supposed to accept would probably make things easier.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, "she" was right too.
But that isn't my definition of correctness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The moment I compromise...
that very instant is my "loss."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur?
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, then.
—For an answer no one else in the world seeks but you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah.
...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I finally caught a glimpse of a breakthrough for my problem.
Feeling refreshed, I headed up to the rooftop...
Only to find someone else was already there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Think you'll be able to sleep well tonight?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't act like you know anything about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Nothin'.
Not a damn thing. The answer's still the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But... if that's how it is, I'll just start over
from the top. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her lead, I looked up at the sky.
Infinitely high, boundlessly vast...
An endless sky.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
None of your damn business.
Go sleep yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a voice called up from below,
shouting Air Shakur's name.
A friendly tone... one of her friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...——
The solution I'm seeking isn't down there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind a whisper barely audible enough to catch,
Air Shakur walked away.
Heading into the darkness where no light shines...——
